template.name: Template OS Linux kernel
template.description: Kernel monitoring: running vs newest installed kernel, the CVEs fixed by a pending reboot, and an optional rEFInd boot-order check.

item.name: Kernel available
item.description: Newest installed kernel in /boot, by version.

item.name: Kernel to boot (newest timestamp)
item.description: Newest /boot/vmlinuz-* by modification time; the kernel rEFInd boots. Empty when rEFInd is not installed.

item.name: Kernel boot state
item.description: Newest-by-version vs newest-by-mtime from one /boot listing: 'ok', or the version rEFInd would boot, or empty when rEFInd is not installed.

trigger.expression: {$KERNEL_BOOT_ENABLED}=1 and last(/Template OS Linux kernel/kernel.boot.state,#1)<>"" and last(/Template OS Linux kernel/kernel.boot.state,#1)<>"ok"
trigger.name: Newest kernel is not the one rEFInd will boot
trigger.description: rEFInd orders boot entries by modification time, so it will boot an older kernel than the newest installed one. Fix: touch /boot/vmlinuz-<newest-version>, then reboot. Evaluated only when {$KERNEL_BOOT_ENABLED}=1.

item.name: Kernel cves
item.description: Number of CVEs fixed by rebooting to the newest installed kernel.

item.name: Kernel cves list
item.description: The CVEs fixed by rebooting to the newest installed kernel, one per line. Used by the optional CVSS add-on.

macro.description: Set to 1 to enable the rEFInd boot-order check.
Optional suffix for the kernel-update alert name, e.g. ', highest CVSS 9.8'. Empty shows the plain name.
Set to 1 on hosts that should get the CVSS suffix from kernel-cve-cvss-push.

trigger.expression: last(/Template OS Linux kernel/kernel.cves,#1)=0 and last(/Template OS Linux kernel/kernel.avail,#1)<>last(/Template OS Linux kernel/kernel.active,#1)
trigger.name: Kernel update available

trigger.expression: last(/Template OS Linux kernel/kernel.cves,#1)>0 and last(/Template OS Linux kernel/kernel.avail,#1)<>last(/Template OS Linux kernel/kernel.active,#1)
trigger.name: Kernel update available ({ITEM.VALUE} cve's{$KERNEL_CVE_CVSS})
